events.text: Spain has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Voice of the Surf (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Atolls, and from [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crab, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, Red Caviar, and Caviar resources)

Carthage has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)
Morocco has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Desert Fox (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from Desert tiles)

The Iroquois have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of Roads (+3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture in cities with a [ICON_CONNECTED] City Connection)

The Inca have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Tears of the Gods (+2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith for each [ICON_RES_GEMS] Gems and [ICON_RES_PLATINUM] Platinum resource, and +2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls resource)

Spain has founded the new religion Judaism in the holy city of Madrid:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Daily Bread[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_PALACE] Palace provides +6 [ICON_FOOD] Food[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Pagodas[ENDCOLOR] Allows you to build Pagodas with [ICON_PEACE] Faith (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith, +4 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness)[NEWLINE][ICON_PEACE] Faith cost on Quick speed: Pagoda 150.
Austria has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Desert Hospitality (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from [ICON_BUILDING_CARAVANSARY] Caravansaries)
A golden age begins for the Carthaginian civilization.

The Inca have founded the new religion Eastern Orthodoxy in the holy city of Cusco:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Church Property[ENDCOLOR] +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each city following this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Hawk Spirit[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_AQUEDUCT] Aqueducts provide +5 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food.

Morocco has founded the new religion Protestantism in the holy city of Marrakech:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Temple Builders[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_PALACE] Palace provides +4 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Fukujin's Bounty[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_CARAVANSARY] Caravansaries provide +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness and +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food. The [ICON_BUILDING_GRAND_EMPORIUM] Grand Emporium provides +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture.
